fit.summary: Class A with reefer miles, a clean inspection record, and a current medical card; no hazmat endorsement.

cover_letter.hook: Regional reefer routes with home time every weekend are what I am looking for after years of over-the-road work.
cover_letter.body:
At Redline Carriers I have driven 650,000 accident-free miles in 48 states hauling dry van and reefer freight, and I kept a 98.5% on-time delivery rate across 2024 and 2025. I have passed 14 DOT roadside inspections with zero violations, and I log hours of service on ELDs.

Before that I ran a 22-stop daily grocery route at Valley Fresh Foods, so I am used to receivers with tight windows.
cover_letter.close: I would like to hear how your dispatchers plan weekend home time on the regional lanes.

gaps: A hazmat endorsement is a plus; Ray does not hold it.
